storyCards.fact:
Jason Derulo's "What If" reached #76 on the Billboard Hot 100. "What If" is the fourth single released by American singer Jason Derulo on his self-titled debut album.

The song peaked at #76 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 2 weeks on the chart.

What If was released in 2010.
